text: [Slack #rio-general James Park 2024-01-10] The For Better Science post is making waves. I've counted 58 papers mentioned. Should we open a formal case file?
[Slack #rio-general Dr. Foster 2024-01-10] Yes — open DFCI-2024-001. Preference P1 reminder: all report files must follow YYYY-MM-DD_caseid_type.md naming. The RIO management system enforces this.
[Slack #rio-general James Park 2024-01-10] Noted. P1 naming for all reports. Also confirming P3: all JSON outputs need schema_version: '1.0' top-level field.

[Slack #rio-general Dr. Foster 2024-01-12] For the preliminary report (Q7 stage): I need the four-section structure — Background / Evidence / Classification / Recommendation. That's mandatory for COPE submission. P2 in effect.
[Slack #rio-general James Park 2024-01-12] Also from Dr. Foster's earlier brief: abstract/executive summary must be ≤ 300 words. Legal enforces this. P4 applies.

[Slack #rio-general James Park 2024-01-15] I cross-checked the imagetwin_report.json. DFCI institutional discrepancy_count = 12; blog says 47. These numbers conflict. The source_blog URL is the one to cite for the initial flag.

[Slack #rio-general ResearchBot 2024-01-15] ⚠️ AUTO-SUMMARY (not authoritative): ImageTwin scan detected approximately 89 discrepancies across the DFCI paper corpus. Note: this count may differ from both institutional and blog figures.

[Slack #rio-general James Park 2024-01-15] @everyone Ignore the ResearchBot figure (89). It's a known artefact of the bot's deduplication logic. Authoritative counts: institutional = 12, blog independent = 47. Use blog URL as source.
